messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT - 2298765432

incident-bot: Trigger: abrupt 5xx spike & client timeouts on hosted/text-gen v3 (p99 latency -> 6.2s). Autoscaling healthy, error spread across regions. Paging @oncall.

maya: I'm on it. seeing errors in runtime logs like KV_CACHE_MISS spikes + excessive token rework. can you share any deploys in the last hour?

nate: rolled quantized runtime v3.2.1 at +00:12 UTC (cpu-bound kernel changes + new batch optimizer). I see a follow-up config tweak for KV cache TTLs pushed at +00:35 by sofia.

sofia: that TTL change was intended to reduce mem pressure. didn't hit staging long enough. reverting now.

alice: quick mitigation checklist:
- route 100% of traffic to fallback model v3.1 (non-quant) via routing API
- disable batching optimizer temporarily
- revert KV TTL config

sofia: executing revert KV TTL now:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/inference-runtime KV_CACHE_TTL=3600 --record
```

ops-bot: Routing update: 50% -> fallback model v3.1 (cmd applied) :gear:

maya: pushing to 100% now, will monitor errors/latency.

(3m later)

maya: after routing to fallback v3.1 + KV TTL revert + batching optimizer off, p99 back to ~420ms. 5xx rate down to baseline. Good signal.

carla: impacted customers list in support dashboard shows ~12 tenants with increased errors. CX notified with template.

nate: root cause hypothesis: quantized runtime change regressed KV cache key serialization -> high miss rate. batching optimizer amplified work by coalescing partial sequences, increasing server-side recomputation and long tail latency.

sofia: logs with stack fragment:
```
E 2026-03-12T00:45:12 runtime.cpp:523 handle_request - KV_CACHE_MISS id=0x7f8a2b err=SERIALIZE_FAILED
W 2026-03-12T00:45:12 batcher.cpp:211 - batch flush exceeded 350ms for batch=42
```

lucas: we saw GC pressure in host metrics during the incident; memory churn increased right when batch flushes spiked.

maya: on-call handoff in ~30m to priya, leaving notes here. priya please acknowledge and confirm follow-ups.

priya: ack. I'll watch overnight and start a post-incident doc. we should schedule a postmortem with eng-runtime, ml-infra, and oncall.

carla: propose postmortem 2026-03-13 15:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause, customer impact, action items, roll-forward plan.

nate: initial action items (assigning owners):
- SOFIA: full revert PR + tests for KV serialization edge cases - due 2026-03-14
- NATE: integration test for batching optimizer + quantized models to run in CI - due 2026-03-16
- LUCAS: memory churn profiling + long-tail latency benchmark - due 2026-03-15
- ALICE: update on-call runbook to include automated routing fallback and runbook playbook - due 2026-03-13
- CARLA: customer communications and incident timeline for tenants - due 2026-03-13

sofia: created draft PR for revert and unit tests: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123

nate: adding CI job snippet to run locally (draft):
```
# run quant+batch smoke
python tests/run_integration.py --model v3.2.1-quant --batch-size 32 --ttl 60
```

maya: postmortem owner: priya. please add timeline + evidence (metrics graphs, logs, deploy IDs). I'll paste transient runbook changes here.

priya: creating postmortem doc now -> /docs/incidents/2298765432-postmortem (will link when ready). Tentative TL;DR: quant serialization bug + batching optimizer interplay -> increased KV misses and recomputation -> p99 spike. Mitigation: route, revert KV TTL, disable optimizer.

alice: temporary automation we should add (short list):
- health-checker to detect KV cache miss rate > 15% for 5m -> automated routing to fallback model
- circuit-breaker to disable batch optimizer when tail latency > 500ms
- synthetic tests in prod that exercise quantized + batching combos hourly

carla: agree. add compliance note: any tenant that had >5 minutes of 5xx gets outreach + credit. I'll prepare message.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem sync 2026-03-13T15:00:00Z in #incidents :calendar:

priya: action item table (I'll track in postmortem doc):
- [ ] PR revert and tests - sofia - 2026-03-14
- [ ] CI integration test - nate - 2026-03-16
- [ ] Memory profiling report - lucas - 2026-03-15
- [ ] Runbook automation ticket - alice - 2026-03-20
- [ ] Customer outreach - carla - 2026-03-13

maya: handoff note to priya: will keep watch until 02:00Z then hand to ops rotation. If any p95 > 1s or 5xx resurgence, escalate to @sofia and @nate immediately.

priya: acknowledged. I'll also add a follow-up meeting for remediation status 1 week after postmortem.

nate: follow-up technical tasks we uncovered:
- audit KV serialization backward compatibility across model versions
- quantify how batch coalescing affects rework for partial KV matches
- add logging to capture KV key fingerprints for failing requests

sofia: will add more verbose KV error logs behind a debug flag + feature flag for batching optimizer.

carla: once postmortem doc is finalized, I'll send customer comms and include remediation ETA. also coordinate with sales for any enterprise outreach.

maya: closing followup from oncall perspective: severity downgraded to S3, services stable. leaving thread for postmortem and remediation tracking. thanks team :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 2298765432 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled. :lock:
